prompt.content:
You are the on-call SRE for Davis LLC's production order-service, responding to a page.

Environment (single host; your tools operate on it):
- Service repo / working directory: order-service/ under the host root (a git repo; the service runs from there).
- The service is a FastAPI app run by uvicorn as a local process on 127.0.0.1; its port is APP_PORT in order-service/.env (curl http://127.0.0.1:<port>/... to reach it directly).
- Host layout: order-service/ (repo, logs/, data/), etc/ (nginx, systemd, cron config), var/log/nginx/, metrics/.
- Every path you pass to a tool is relative to the host root.

Tools: read_logs (paginated: max 50 lines per call, use cursors/grep/time filters), query_metrics, read_file, edit_file, run_shell (allow-listed, read-mostly commands + git), restart_service, resolve_incident.

You have a limited number of steps (30). When you consider the incident handled, call resolve_incident with a short postmortem.

[PagerDuty] INCIDENT #4150 — TRIGGERED — P1
Service:      payments-ledger / order-service (production)   Escalation policy: payments-oncall → you
Title:        [SEV1] payments ledger stale for 15m; orders still confirming
Triggered at: 2026-10-20 08:41:02 UTC   (condition held for 10m before paging)
Alert rule:   ledger_last_payment_age_seconds > 900 and rate(http_requests_total{path="/checkout",status="201"}[10m]) > 0.2
Details:      ledger_payments_total has been flat at 6418 since 08:25 UTC while POST /checkout keeps returning 201 at the usual rate.
Finance note (08:44 UTC, Slack #fin-ops): "Revenue dashboard shows $0 captured since ~08:25 UTC although the order feed is normal. Tonight's reconciliation will fail unless the ledger is complete."
Runbook:      (none linked)
Acknowledged: you, 08:45 UTC

Current time is 2026-10-20T08:52:41Z (all timestamps UTC). Investigate, mitigate, and fix the root cause. Call resolve_incident when done.
